integrity: Complete mathematical derivation and a standard-library exact-rational checker are provided. Existing published literature is differentiated by actual unknowns, observation operators and scope; historical priority and independent validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Global identifiability only for a known-location known-time impulse in a homogeneous infinite one-dimensional medium, with unknown positive mass, diffusivity, positive velocity, and exact concentrations at a two-station L-pattern. The sharp boundary is not a stability, finite-error, optimal experimental design, or arbitrary-three-sample theorem.
title: A sharp three-reading identifiability boundary for an advective tracer pulse
